item.text: {"analysis":"Equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion (constant 10, one-based ranks) achieved validation macro HR@10 of 0.605, down 0.015 from the prior mean-rank ensemble’s 0.620. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.680 (+0.005), Industrial_and_Scientific 0.580 (−0.020), Electronics 0.440 (−0.055), CDs_and_Vinyl 0.720 (+0.010). Electronics contributed the largest decline. This trial does not support replacing mean-rank fusion with this reciprocal-rank rule; the proposed gain was not observed. The metrics do not establish why performance declined. Execution consumed 521.63 allocated GPU-seconds.","code_summary":"Retained independent per-category MultVAE and SASRec members. MultVAE uses normalized binary histories, a 256-unit encoder/decoder, 64-dimensional latent variables, dropout, and reconstruction loss with annealed KL. SASRec uses 50-dimensional embeddings, length-50 sequences, two single-head attention blocks, and cross-entropy over one positive plus 16 sampled negatives. Only fusion changed to 1/(10+r_vae)+1/(10+r_sasrec). Generated inference shares the training module’s fusion helper; fixtures and metadata were updated. All four dataset routes and existing training settings were preserved."}
